2.  25-54874  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from ORALE regarding the
  Long Beach Values Act.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Montgomery, seconded by
  Commissioner Lara, to approve recommendation as amended, to [1] form an
  Ad Hoc Committee to draft a letter to City Council within 2 weeks,
  recommending that City Council take up the policy recommendations to allow
  for a private right of action for the Long Beach Values Act and close the Long
  Beach Values Act SB54 exclusions; [2] add to the City Council agenda by the
  end of June 2025 indicating Equity and Human Relations Commission’s
  support of these changes; and [3] recommend that the Budget for the Long
  Beach Justice Fund become structural at a number no less than $2.2 million.
  The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  10 De Leon, Gillette, Lara, Lissette Flores, McNeill, Montgomery, Samé-
  Weil, Schultz, Batts, Covington
  No:  1 Koll
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
